The statement reads: lemma lemma: weakly complementary central Let X be any bounded hoop and e 1, e 2 any two weakly complementary central elements. Then the induced map [ X [e 1 X] [e 2 X] ] is surjective. It is injective if and only if e 1 and e 2 admit a join and that join is 1.
